statement: For every family of closed unit squares with pairwise disjoint interiors inside a square of side 4675531/1000000, read in the frame with the container centre at (1169/500, 1169/500), the sum of tau(pose) over the squares is less than 17, where tau(pose) is the least threshold among the classes that contain the pose and 1 if no class contains it. A class is the listed slots united with their eight D4 images (angle gates with all quarter-turn lifts). Classes: marker_orbit_exempt threshold 0 (1 slots).
